# webtables/callfn

> Calling a function value: call_indirect through the program's function table.

truck [webtables](../webtables.md) · [source](../../../registry/webtables/callfn.pkg) · translates [std/callfn](../std/callfn.md)

Every generated function has the type `() -> i64` and takes its arguments
from the memory stack, so one table type covers them all. The arguments
are pushed right to left as in [call](call.md), then the value is
evaluated: an index into the table from 1, where 0 is `null` and panics.

## Emit variants

The first variant whose condition holds is used.

### `emit`

```nasm
(block (result i64)
{each args reverse}
(call $__pk_push
{it}
)
{end}
(call $__pk_callfn
{f}
))
@panic
```

Includes: [webtables/panic](panic.md)

## Support code (once per program)

```nasm
(func $__pk_callfn (param $f i64) (result i64)
(if (i64.eqz (local.get $f)) (then (call $__pk_panic_nullfn)))
(call_indirect $__pk_fns (type $__pk_fnt) (i32.wrap_i64 (i64.sub (local.get $f) (i64.const 1)))))
```
